completed.result: Cache/prepared-query hygiene thread closed as strategy; Set-A/Set-B scorecard adopted; all-app runner guarded.

current_distance_to_v3.plain_summary: Phoenix V3 has a real prepared runtime trunk credential on RTDBSCAN, but no accepted material runtime-sourced performance win from that route. V3 remains redo_required, not release-ready.

next_goals.purpose: Check whether RayJoin legacy path materializes an inter-phase LSI-to-PIP/overlay intermediate to host; without this source, RayJoin would likely repeat RTDBSCAN parity.
exit_criteria: Document exact legacy RayJoin phase boundaries.
Record whether intermediate rows/arrays cross the host boundary.
Select RayJoin only if a real V3 runtime source exists.
next_goals.stop_or_pivot_condition: If legacy RayJoin is already device-resident across phases, stop RayJoin as the next material probe and audit Barnes-Hut instead.

next_goals.purpose: Route RayJoin through the same productized prepared-session runner without app-specific engine semantics.
exit_criteria: Internal V3 residency metadata is present.
No external device-buffer or embedding claim appears.
Local focused tests cover the new runner path.
next_goals.stop_or_pivot_condition: If the implementation requires app-specific native ABI or external host buffer ownership, reject it as not V3.

next_goals.purpose: Measure runner vs legacy RayJoin on the same RT hardware and same dataset family.
exit_criteria: Runner vs legacy speedup is reported, not runner vs a weaker control.
Material candidate only if the gain is runtime-sourced and clears the focused bar.
Claude or other external review records a verdict.
next_goals.stop_or_pivot_condition: If runner vs legacy is parity or slower, record RayJoin as structural/no-go and move to Barnes-Hut; do not tune caches.

next_goals.purpose: Prove the trunk generalizes beyond one family, preferably Barnes-Hut frontier/vector accumulation if RayJoin does not produce a material source.
exit_criteria: A second Set-A family flows through the same runner pattern.

Result is classified as material, parity, or no-go before any all-app run.
next_goals.stop_or_pivot_condition: If two honest Set-A families with real performance sources both fail, trigger capability/quality-framing review instead of further speed claims.

next_goals.purpose: Run full V2.14 vs Phoenix V3 only after enough focused runtime-sourced Set-A probes justify pod spend.
exit_criteria: Set-A and Set-B classification frozen before the run.

next_goals.stop_or_pivot_condition: If focused probes do not show material runtime-sourced wins, do not run all-app.

budget_guidance.near_term_pod_need: Keep pod use minimal until RayJoin or Barnes-Hut has a confirmed performance source.
budget_guidance.first_go_no_go_window: G1 through G3 needs roughly 3 to 7 wall hours if RayJoin has a source, with about 0.5 to 1.75 pod hours.
budget_guidance.first_go_no_go_cost_usd_at_1_usd_per_4h: about 0.13 to 0.44 USD of pod time
budget_guidance.full_release_candidate_window: A responsible release-candidate path needs at least two focused family results, then one all-app run and external review. Expect roughly 8 to 18 wall hours plus 3 to 8 pod hours if the engineering path works.
budget_guidance.full_release_candidate_pod_cost_usd_at_1: about 0.75 to 2.00 USD of pod time
budget_guidance.risk: If RayJoin and Barnes-Hut both fail as material runtime-sourced probes, Phoenix V3 should be reframed or redesigned instead of spending more pod time.

goal_level_decision_audit.decision: Stop treating RTDBSCAN as a material probe and make RayJoin legacy-materialization audit the next controlled goal.
goal_level_decision_audit.was_i_foolish: No for this decision; yes would be continuing RTDBSCAN micro-tuning or all-app runs after a 0.994858x incumbent result.
goal_level_decision_audit.foolish_actions: Counting runner-vs-Embree as V3 speedup, ignoring the legacy-vs-Embree baseline, or spending pod time before identifying a real inter-phase cost to remove.
goal_level_decision_audit.other_path: The old path was cache hygiene and blended all-app geomean. It already produced 1.012x and did not solve V3.
goal_level_decision_audit.different_path_now: Audit a new Set-A family for a real runtime performance source, then run a focused A/B only if that source exists.
